note: Cross-surface tape-semantics fingerprint. build.rs hashes the seven named source files followed by suite-dependencies.v1.toml, a canonical record derived from Cargo.toml by build_support.rs. It binds exact versions and features of sharpebench-core, sharpebench-protocol and sharpebench-sim without depending on Cargo's package-manifest rewriting. The manual epoch covers changes outside those inputs, including non-suite dependencies. This fingerprint is a compatibility check, not cryptographic attestation of every transitive dependency or the toolchain. Python and npm wrappers pin the engine value and refuse mismatches.
algorithm: fnv1a-64 seeded with fnv1a-64(offset_basis, epoch); each input contributes UTF-8 file name, NUL, canonical byte length as little-endian u64, then bytes with CRLF normalized to LF (lone CR retained)
